goal: Add failure detection and recovery to the validated Panda manipulation envelope.
active_hypotheses: Fresh-state MuJoCo candidate rollouts can improve first-attempt physical task selection.
Feedback control generalizes better than nominal open-loop control under moderate dynamics variation.
A fixed open-source robot model can reuse FDB candidate simulation and objective evaluation boundaries.
unresolved_questions: How should rotate be evaluated independently from translation?
Which orientation representation and collision metric should gate pre-grasp reach?
next_gate: Inject missed grasp, dropped object, and failed placement cases; detect each failure and select a bounded recovery plan.
